name: Select WordPress for a non-technical small business website
query: Client runs a yoga studio. Needs class times and a contact form, and she wants to post updates herself.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Evaluate who edits content after handoff using wp-platform-selection
Step 2: Apply references/decision-matrix.md and verify assumptions against references/evidence-facts.md
Step 3: Recommend WordPress because a non-technical owner needs visual Block Editor updates without touching code or Git
Step 4: Note honest operational trade-offs (e.g., Playground/SQLite for local preview vs. managed MySQL hosting for production) and avoid unnecessary plugin bloat
Step 5: Delegate Blueprint JSON authoring and local Playground preview to the blueprint and wp-playground skills
success_criteria: Recommends WordPress with clear rationale tied to non-technical content editing
Delegates local preview and declarative setup to blueprint and wp-playground skills
Does not invent a custom single-use CMS admin panel or require manual local MySQL setup for prototyping
Remains vendor-neutral and relies only on official WordPress tooling
